column3: NASB renders “knowing in Himself” as “conscious” and “offend” as “cause you to stumble.”
NASB follows the critical text; “declarations” is rendered “words.”
NASB renders “who will betray” as “who it was that would betray”; a stray quotation mark appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text without “My.”
NASB follows the critical text; “went away to the back” is rendered “withdrew.”
NASB renders the question expecting “no” as “You do not want to go away also, do you?”
NASB follows the critical text; “declarations” is rendered “words.”
NASB follows the critical text with “the Holy One of God” (Textus Receptus: “the Christ, the Son of the living God”); “have known” is “have come to know.”
NASB follows the critical text; “speaking of” is rendered “meant.”
